recommended_structure.template: Lean, cut to one campaign and one ad set
why: Weekly events the budget can buy: $350 a week / $40 per sign-up = 8.8, under 10, the 'not learning' band. One ad set gets every event; a second would halve that.
No custom audiences exist (0), so there is no retargeting campaign; its share goes to prospecting.
Advantage+ audience is on, so interest ad sets would mostly reach the same people as the broad one.
With one ad set, a campaign budget adds nothing (CBO needs 3+ ad sets), so the $50/day sits on the ad set.
recommended_structure.learning_note: At about 8.8 sign-ups a week the ad set will likely stay in limited learning. Once the pixel is in, consider optimising an earlier, more frequent event the sign-up page sends, or accept slower learning; revisit when sign-ups pass 50 a week.
